Container.Name: sharedrive
Container.Overview: Sharedrive — self-hosted private file drive with user management, per-user quotas, file sharing, admin dashboard, audit logging, and Cloudflare tunnel support. Requires sharedrive-postgres and sharedrive-redis to be running first.
Container.Requires: 1. Docker network "cloudflare" must already exist (shared with your cloudflared container). 2. Docker network "privatedrive-net" must exist. Create with: docker network create privatedrive-net 3. sharedrive-postgres container must be running. 4. sharedrive-redis container must be running. 5. Copy .env.example to the config path below, rename to .env, and fill in all values before starting.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Container timezone. See https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_tz_database_time_zones for valid values.

Config.Name: Config File (.env)
Config.Description: Full path to the .env configuration file on the host. Copy .env.example from the repo, rename to .env, and fill in all required values before starting the container.

Config.Name: Files Storage
Config.Description: Path on the host where uploaded files will be stored. Ensure this directory exists and has sufficient free space.

Config.Name: Backups Storage
Config.Description: Path on the host where exported backup archives will be stored.
